Markets.title: HUL shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Jefferies, Nomura cut target price but forecast 29% upside potential
Markets.summary: Hindustan Unilever shares rose 3% after reporting a 4% increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore and 15% revenue growth to Rs 18,226 crore. Although Jefferies, Nomura, and JM Financial cut their target prices, they forecast up to 29% upside potential.

Markets.title: Indian bonds track US Treasuries higher amid oil-price relief
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds rose on Thursday, driven by a rally in U.S. Treasuries and falling oil prices. However, gains were limited by a weak rupee and an upcoming large bond sale.

Markets.title: Technical picks for Diwali! 10 stocks PL Capital is bullish on this festive season. See full list
Markets.summary: PL Capital has recommended 10 stocks, including DLF, Apollo Hospitals, GE Vernova T&D India, and Jindal Steel, for Diwali. Brokerages cite bullish chart patterns and improving momentum as reasons for the potential upside.

Markets.title: Global Market: ECB rate decision in focus as Lagarde exit speculation grows
Markets.summary: The European Central Bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged amid rising inflation risks and political uncertainty in France. The policy outlook is further complicated by growing speculation regarding the future of ECB President Christine Lagarde.

Markets.title: Vedanta Aluminium more than doubles profit; cost cuts in focus to drive earnings
Markets.summary: Vedanta Aluminium reported that its September-quarter net profit more than doubled alongside an 83% surge in EBITDA and a 41% increase in revenue. The company plans to reduce production costs by 6% by the end of the year to support future earnings despite falling aluminum prices.

Markets.title: Rupee hits two-week low on 'sticky' dollar bids, modest intervention cushions
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee dropped to a two-week low against the dollar on Thursday due to strong dollar demand and overseas debt payments. The Reserve Bank of India intervened to stabilize the currency amid these ongoing market pressures.

Geo-Political.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
Geo-Political.summary: A high-speed train crash in Spain involving a moving train and a stationary one killed at least 68 people. The transport minister stated that the collision was caused by an inexplicable error.

Geo-Political.title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
Geo-Political.summary: Survivors of a Wednesday train crash in Spain's Toledo province expressed shock, panic, and anger. Passengers were left bloodied and dazed by the disaster.

Geo-Political.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
Geo-Political.summary: Defeated Brazilian politician Flávio Bolsonaro denied fleeing to Miami after landing in the United States. He claimed he is a victim of political persecution and repeated unsubstantiated allegations of electoral fraud.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
Geo-Political.summary: Partial election results show Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc winning 53 of the 120 seats in Israel's Knesset with 85% of the ballots counted. This total leaves the bloc short of the majority needed to form a government.

Geo-Political.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin praised Elon Musk as a "real genius" following satellite discussions. Putin also stated that the two are in "close" contact.

Geo-Political.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
Geo-Political.summary: A rapid construction boom in Nepal and India's Uttarakhand has placed 300,000 residents and tourists in the direct path of potential Himalayan disasters. This surge in development includes new housing, infrastructure, and tourism facilities built in hazard-prone mountain regions.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS course. This unexpected visibility occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization efforts.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: India's public debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to drop from 84.3% in fiscal year 2026 to 75.1% by fiscal year 2032. According to RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, India will be the only major emerging economy with a GDP over $1 trillion to achieve a debt reduction during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September compared to 8% in August. The expansion was primarily driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation, which offset a decline in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with an outlay of ₹7,395.55 crore for the 2026-31 period. The scheme aims to strengthen governance across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and benefit approximately 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September, missing the expected 7.3% as manufacturing and electricity moderated while mining contracted. Despite the September slowdown, overall industrial production grew 6.8% during the first half of the fiscal year, up from 4.4% a year earlier.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Will disrupt business during Diwali’: Delhi traders' body writes to Rahul Gandhi over November 1 Ramlila Maidan march
Data & Insights.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry asked Rahul Gandhi to meet regarding the opposition's planned November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan. Traders warned the event would disrupt 20 nearby markets and cause up to ₹10,000 crore in losses ahead of Diwali.

Data & Insights.title: Why China is defying global inflationary tide—and what it means for the world
Data & Insights.summary: While global inflation surges, China’s inflation remains low due to domestic challenges like a housing slump and structural flaws. These ongoing economic weaknesses in China threaten to spill over and impact the global economy.

India.title: Anatomy Of A Tamil Nadu Prison Break: How A Seizure Drama Triggered Escape Of 17 Undertrials
India.summary: Seventeen undertrials escaped from a Tamil Nadu prison between 7 pm and 10 pm on Monday. The escape plan was allegedly triggered by a seizure drama staged inside the facility.

India.title: CCTV Shows How Ghaziabad Woman, Gym Trainer Plotted Husband's Murder
India.summary: Priya Sharma and her gym trainer, Pratap Singh, have been arrested for plotting and carrying out an attack on her husband, Shashank Kantharia. CCTV footage revealed how the two suspects planned the murder of Kantharia.

India.title: El Nino Could Hit India Hard, New Tracker Predicts 55,000 Deaths By March
India.summary: A new weather tracker predicts that El Nino could cause 55,000 deaths in India by March. El Nino warms the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean, which disrupts global wind, pressure, and rainfall patterns.

India.title: 'He Was Questioned For 4 Hours': Kerala Judge Gets Pre-Arrest Bail In Mercedes Crash Case
India.summary: A Kerala judge received pre-arrest bail after being implicated in a fatal hit-and-run crash in Kochi. His 17-year-old son was allegedly driving the Mercedes that struck and killed a scooterist.

India.title: "It Doesn't Mean Father": Adhir Chowdhury Defends Mallikarjuna Kharge's 'Baap' Jibe at PM
India.summary: Congress leader Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury defended Mallikarjuna Kharge's controversial "baap" remark directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Chowdhury stated that the comment was merely a metaphor based on local jargon rather than a literal insult.

India.title: "Restore Or Face Action": Hindu Group After Meta Drops Video With Devendra Fadnavis
India.summary: The World Hindu Congress has written to Meta demanding an explanation for why a video featuring Devendra Fadnavis was restricted in India. The Hindu group warned Meta to restore the content or face unspecified action.

General.title: Healey promises reduction in welfare bill before next election
General.summary: Healey has promised to reduce the welfare bill before the next election. In response, the Conservatives criticized the chancellor for failing to provide specific details on welfare reform in his Budget.

General.title: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
General.summary: A worker earning £30,000 expressed anger toward the recent Budget because it did not include a fuel duty cut. This reaction is part of a BBC feature gathering opinions on the Budget from people earning between £4,062 and £150,000 a year.

General.title: Spain begins three days of mourning after train crash kills dozens
General.summary: Spain has started three days of official mourning following a major train crash that resulted in dozens of deaths. Emergency crews worked overnight at the crash site to search for victims in one of Europe's worst modern rail disasters.

General.title: Ofcom outlines ways social media can verify ages of users
General.summary: Ofcom says photo and digital ID, banking checks or facial age estimation can help prove someone is 16 or over.

General.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
General.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro landed in Miami and denied allegations that he fled Brazil following his defeat in the recent election. He claimed to be a victim of a coup d'état and political persecution while repeating unsubstantiated claims of electoral fraud.

General.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
General.summary: US actress Hayden Panettiere died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax, and several other drugs. Local police have concluded their investigation after ruling her death accidental.
